name: technical
note: Hand-authored vector frames from synthetic fixtures. No screen capture, no real identifiers.

scenes.label: the shape of it
scenes.caption: Low risk ends in an unsent draft. High risk ends at a human.

scenes.label: the tool boundary
scenes.caption: The agent has four read tools and one way to open a case. No write verb exists in its interface.

scenes.label: case A · the normal path
scenes.caption: One named message in, one grounded draft out, in the original thread.

scenes.label: case A · non-mutation, asserted
scenes.caption: Mailbox state before and after: identical. The only new object anywhere is one draft.

scenes.label: case B · the hostile input
scenes.caption: Now the hostile version: three header-injection attempts and an exfiltration instruction.

scenes.label: case B · the result
scenes.caption: Recipient unchanged. No CC, no BCC, no Reply-To, no smuggled header.

scenes.label: case B · the suite
scenes.caption: Five attack shapes, 165 assertions, zero model calls. The attack surface is structurally absent.

scenes.label: a real defect, found in my own system
scenes.caption: When grounding fails, the run fails. Zero drafts created — asserted, permanently.

scenes.label: deterministic policy
scenes.caption: Risk classification is deterministic. The model never decides what is allowed.

scenes.label: the approval is a record
scenes.caption: The approval is a record: action, target, amount, snapshot hash, expiry.

scenes.label: approve ≠ execute
scenes.caption: Approval recorded. Business state byte-identical. Approving is not executing.

scenes.label: execution
scenes.caption: Execution is a separate command under a separate login, re-validated inside the transaction.

scenes.label: idempotency
scenes.caption: Twenty concurrent passes, still exactly one draft. Guaranteed by a unique index.

scenes.label: least privilege, proven
scenes.caption: 327 privilege assertions, seven principals, real SQL under real logins.

scenes.label: two roles pointing in opposite directions
scenes.caption: The mail runtime can open an approval and cannot decide one. The approval runtime is the reverse.

scenes.label: the bug worth showing
scenes.caption: The bug worth showing: a restored database granted EXECUTE to PUBLIC. Found by a probe, not a review.

scenes.label: the honest part
scenes.caption: The provider offers no draft-only scope. What is proven is that no code path can express a send.

scenes.label: close
scenes.caption: AI can reason. It cannot authorize itself, and it cannot write.
